visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera pans across the exterior of a grey metal public restroom at Wuling Pavilion. The ground is completely covered in a thick layer of white snow and ice. Three orange traffic cones with white stripes are positioned near the entrance. The building's roof and walls are frosted with ice, and a foggy mountain landscape is visible in the background through a metal railing. (2) The camera moves closer to a stone washbasin. The interior of the basin is filled with solid, frozen water, showing a thick layer of ice instead of a drain. A silver metal faucet stands above it, but no water flows. The surface of the stone is covered in white frost, and white plastic bottles of hand soap sit nearby on the counter. (3) The camera enters the interior of the restroom facility. The floor consists of dark grey tiles, and the stall doors are made of light brown wood with silver handles. A white ceramic urinal is visible on the right side. The overall lighting is provided by bright overhead artificial lights, and the narrator continues to point out that even the toilets are frozen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 臺灣最高的公廁 雪地都結冰水. (2) [Subtitle]: 台灣最高的公廁. (3) [Subtitle]: 武嶺亭的公廁. (4) [Subtitle]: 水龍頭都結冰. (5) [Subtitle]: 這整塊都是冰的. (6) [Subtitle]: 都出不了水了，沒辦法用水. (7) [Subtitle]: 廁所上面全是冰. (8) [Subtitle]: 馬桶都結冰了無法出水.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A grey metallic public restroom building covered in frost and ice at a high-altitude location. The outdoor area is blanketed in snow with metal railings overlooking a foggy mountain ridge. The interior features grey tiled floors and wooden stall doors.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice provides clear, neutral narration in Mandarin, explaining that this is the highest public toilet in Taiwan. The background audio is dominated by the low-frequency hum of outdoor wind and the distinct, crunchy sounds of footsteps walking on packed snow and ice. There is no background music, allowing the natural environmental sounds to be heard clearly. (2) As the narrator describes the frozen faucets, his voice remains steady with moderate pitch and clear articulation. The sound of footsteps becomes more muffled as the person steps onto a slightly more sheltered area near the sinks. The acoustic atmosphere remains quiet, lacking any sound of running water or metallic clinking, which reinforces the visual narrative of everything being frozen solid. (3) The recording transitions as the speaker moves inside the restroom building. A subtle change in room tone is audible, with a slight increase in mid-frequency resonance typical of a small, tiled indoor space. The narrator’s voice continues without interruption, his volume consistent, as he describes the frozen state of the toilets inside. No mechanical flushing or water sounds are present in the mix.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and showcase the extreme freezing conditions at Taiwan's highest public restroom in Wuling during a snow event, highlighting that all water facilities have been rendered unusable by ice.

high_inference.freeDescribe: An informative first-person vlog capturing a rare weather phenomenon in Taiwan's high mountains.
